name: Gwen
notes: Needlework (R) is cast at the engine's forced opening (t=0) and is recast twice more at its fixed 1-second static interval (unaffected by ability haste) to fire all 1+3+5=9 needles; its base cooldown (80-120s) will not come back up inside an 8-15s fight so it is only ever cast this once.

A Thousand Cuts (P) is applied to every basic attack on-hit and to every individual snip of Snip Snip! (each mini-snip and the final snip) and to every needle of Needlework, per the wiki's 'the center of each snip ... applies A Thousand Cuts' wording; the open question of once-per-cast vs once-per-instance is resolved in favor of once-per-instance since the dummy is always in the center of the cone/line.
A Thousand Cuts' 67%-of-damage heal (and its cap) is not modeled: healing does not affect the damage fight.
Hallowed Mist (W) is never cast: it deals no damage and only grants resistances/untargetability, which do not matter to a stationary, non-attacking dummy.

The minion/monster-only clauses of P and Q (bonus execute damage below 40% minion health, the 3(+5%AP) monster cap, Snip Snip!'s 80% minion damage and its 20%-health minion execute) do not apply against a champion-type dummy and are omitted.

Snippy stacks are simulated organically from the actual attack timeline (one stack per landed attack, capped at 4, the whole stack count expiring 6s after the most recent attack) rather than assumed pre-stacked, so early Q casts may fire with fewer bonus mini-snips.

Snip Snip! has a 0.5 s cast time (gen.Q.castTimeS): all its mini-snips and the final snip land together at the cast (the wiki's stated per-snip timings inside the cast window are not modeled as separate delays), and the cast then keeps Gwen busy for that 0.5 s before any other cast or attack, per the cast-times rule.

Snip Snip!'s cast fires (1 + current Snippy stacks) mini-snips plus one final snip; the center of each snip converts 50% of that snip's own damage to true damage before A Thousand Cuts (a separate, un-split magic instance) is added.

Skip 'n Slash (E) is cast on cooldown: it resets Gwen's basic attack timer, empowers the next attacks for 4s with on-hit magic damage and bonus attack speed, and the first empowered attack that lands discounts E's remaining cooldown by the stated percentage. It has no cast time, but still waits for any cast already in progress (Snip Snip!'s cast time).
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15s fight at level 16.
